text: Ha, can you believe we actually did it? We made it through the storm. Wind howling, rain lashing, I thought we'd never see the sun again. There were nights nights I cried myself to sleep, whispering, Is anyone even out there? But then you showed up. You smiled and suddenly the world wasn't so dark. I felt seen, understood. Then builds Remember that silly dance in the kitchen with burnt pancakes? Oh we were a mess. But now now you've gone. The silence is deafening. I miss you every single day, but I carry you with me in every laugh, every tear, every quiet moment. And I'll keep going because that's what you would want. Always.
